# Flying

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Movement](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Flying)*

A variety of effects allow a creature to fly. While flying, you fall if you have the [Incapacitated](../Conditions/Incapacitated.md) or [Prone](../Conditions/Prone.md) condition or your Fly Speed is reduced to 0. You can stay aloft in those circumstances if you can hover. *See also* "[Falling](../Exploration/Hazards/Falling.md)" and "[Fly Speed](Fly-Speed.md)."
